text: It looks like Betsy knocked over the log pile jumping through the window. Can you help me pick them up?
notes: Warm, a little amused. Real question; pause after.

text: Find the log with the letter
notes: Say this, then the letter name plays right after. End the line up-tone, no pause at the end.

text: Hmm... look closely at the logs. I think I see it!
notes: After 2 wrong taps. The engine pulses the right log.

text: There it is! Tap the log that's sparkling.
notes: After 4 wrong taps. The engine picks it up for her.
Plays after one of the first four logs. Cheerful.

text: Thank you for all your help, Reign! And look! Betsy's paw prints lead into the forest!
notes: Excited on 'look'. Three small paw prints appear on the trail while you say it.
Used when she taps the wrong letter: 'That's' + the letter name + 'Find the log with the letter' + the target. Keep it flat and friendly, never scolding.
Excited, last line of the scene. Plays right after the paw prints line.
